quizSteps.question: Where is your career right now?
quizSteps.sub: Choose the option that best describes your current professional situation.

options.label: I work in a related field — finance, consulting, engineering, or O&G — and want to move into commodity trading
I already work inside a commodity trading firm — in operations, scheduling, ETRM, or a support function
I work in analytics, quant, or data science and want to move toward a trading or commercial role
I work at a vendor firm selling data, intelligence, or services to the commodity trading community
I am a student, fresh graduate, or early in my career with limited professional experience

quizSteps.question: What is your target role or function in commodity trading?
quizSteps.sub: Pick the function that is closest to your goal.

options.label: Front office — Trader, originator, or commercial manager

quizSteps.question: Which best describes your biggest resume challenge right now?
quizSteps.sub: Be honest — this is what the template is designed to solve.

options.label: Translating my experience from another industry into commodity trading language
Making my operational experience sound commercial, not just functional
Making my technical or analytical skills relevant to a commercial role
Reframing vendor/sales achievements as market knowledge, not quota attainment
I lack professional experience and need to show commercial curiosity instead
